meta.title: Calendly — Keep Your Circle’s Schedule in Sync
meta.description: Calendar, tasks, and member profiles in one place. Built for families, travel groups, and small teams. Lightweight — not everyone needs the app.

hero.title: The simplest way to keep your circle in sync
hero.subtitle: Calendar, tasks, assignments, and member profiles — for families, travel groups, and clubs. Clear and light, with organizer-managed profiles for people who don’t install the app.
hero.imageBrief: Hero composite: main calendar week view with multi-member colored events, phone app home overlapping bottom-right (calendar / todos visible). Device stack only — no extra badges.

guide.title: Get started fast
guide.subtitle: A few steps to organize your circle’s schedule and to-dos.

steps.title: Create a circle and invite members
steps.description: Set up your family or group and bring collaborators in.

steps.title: Add profiles for people without the app
steps.description: Include elders, kids, or temporary companions in one shared schedule.

steps.title: Add events and tasks
steps.description: Separate shared to-dos from personal tasks — clear owners, trackable progress.

guide.imageBrief: Onboarding visual: circle member list + invite/profile UI with avatars and roles clearly visible.

calendar.title: Flexible calendar views
calendar.description: Switch between day, week, and month to match your circle’s rhythm. See who’s busy at a glance.
calendar.imageBrief: Calendar multi-view screenshot: prefer week or month with multi-member colored blocks; optional phone day view overlay.

tasks.title: Tasks & lists
tasks.description: Keep shared to-dos and personal tasks separate. Shopping, rotations, event prep — every item has an owner.
tasks.imageBrief: Tasks/lists UI with multiple lists or cards, completion state and assignees; tablet + phone stack preferred.

members.title: Member profiles
members.description: No need for everyone to install the app. Organizers can create profiles for elders, children, or external collaborators.
members.imageBrief: Members/group management: member list, profile cards, or assignee picker highlighting no-download profiles.

sync.title: Sync across devices
sync.description: Check on the go from mobile, plan from the web console — everything stays in sync.
sync.imageBrief: Multi-device shot: web console calendar on the left, phone app showing the same schedule on the right.

appPromo.title: Free mobile app
appPromo.description: Manage your circle’s schedule and to-dos anywhere — Calendly stays with you.
appPromo.imageBrief: 1–2 clean phone screens (calendar home or todos). Frameless OK for inserting into a phone mockup.

capabilities.sectionSubtitle: Bring plans that live in chat into one clear toolkit.

members.description: Give each member a clear identity so schedules are easy to read.

sync.title: Cross-device sync
sync.description: App and web console stay in sync — no forked information.

lists.title: Custom lists
lists.description: Group tasks, shopping, and prep items for the whole circle.

privacy.title: Privacy first
privacy.description: Apple Sign In and modern cloud architecture to protect circle data.
